The '''DuraShelter''' was a collapsible one-person tent. It was carried in a pack about the size of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. It was covered in [[di-chrome]] and was lined with thermal insulation. The covering helped camouflage the shelter and insulation could protect the user from severe weather.
